Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the Planner incorrectly deduced that the character who pulled Excalibur from the stone was "Captain Hook" based on the WebSurfer's initial mention of "Rumple Removes Excalibur" and a confusion with the character Sir Kay (who failed to pull it). The Planner failed to verify this deduction against the search results which clearly identified King Arthur as the one who successfully pulled the sword. This incorrect identification of the character led to the search for the wrong actor (Colin O'Donoghue) instead of the correct one (Liam Garrigan).
